::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 19th 1877  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 16
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)

Thank you for sending me this letter, I am very glad that there should be a Hindostanee translation. I have just heard of one nearer home into German

Yours truly
C M Yonge
